The bar shows a red dashed badge 'Stale — reload the extension' beside the walkdown logo, whose title names the full fix (reload the extension at chrome://extensions, then reload the page). Measured with Playwright, not just queried: at 1440, 1280 and 1024 the badge spans x 126–332 with scrollWidth equal to clientWidth (203) and sits wholly inside the left cluster's clip edge (584, 504, 376), so the words read whole — the n-0292 clipping at 1280 is gone. The negatives hold: with build set to the server's own panelHash (240759eb97d4) the badge is absent, and with no build hash at all (the script-tag delivery's shape) it is absent too. During the sitting the served panel.js was rebuilt under me (panelHash 2a180ff91d26 -> 240759eb97d4) and a hash that had matched became stale — the badge appeared for exactly the reason the rule exists.
